profile.headline: SOFTWARE ENGINEER || AI DEVELOPER || MOBILE APP DEVELOPER || FULL STACK DEVELOPER
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building scalable web and mobile applications using modern technologies such as React, Laravel, Python and Flutter. I specialize in developing responsive user interfaces, integrating APIs, and designing efficient backend systems that solve real-world problems.
 
I have worked on a range of projects including hospital management systems, conference platforms, and educational web applications. Through these experiences, I’ve developed a strong ability to write clean, maintainable code and deliver functional, user-focused solutions.
 
Beyond development, I have experience mentoring and guiding aspiring developers, which has strengthened my communication skills and deepened my understanding of software architecture and best practices.
 
I am passionate about continuous learning, collaboration, and building impactful digital products. I am currently open to remote opportunities where I can contribute, grow, and work with forward-thinking teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineered and deployed diverse web applications including specialized hospital management and conference hosting platforms. Built cross-platform mobile applications and scalable tech educational websites. Collaborated on the design and implementation of secure, corporate-standard software architectures. Optimized technical infrastructure to support enterprise-level software operations.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Developed dynamic web solutions using PHP, Laravel, and modern JavaScript frameworks. Architected responsive interfaces and educational portals using Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, and preprocessors (Sass/Less). Guided developers in mastering industry-standard coding practices and full-stack architecture.
